cost.binNote: Wiki lists cost as '1 Spell Shard' but bin cost values are all 0; the '1' is a shard, not mana.

values.binNote: Simple 3x multiple of per-bolt tooltip; no dedicated bin row, restated total, but kept since bolt count matters for damage fight timing.

values.meaning: Duration Zoe can cast a mimicked summoner spell after collecting a Spell Shard
values.quote: holding it for up to 60 seconds

mechanics.claim: The three bolts fire one at a time at the nearest non-sleeping enemy in range, prioritizing Zoe's attack target, each dealing a separate instance of magic damage.
mechanics.quote: she shoots one bolt at a time at the nearest non-{{tip|sleep|sleeping}} enemy in range, prioritizing her attack target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} with each bolt

mechanics.claim: Zoe gains the bonus movement speed and summons the three bolts whenever she casts Spell Thief or a summoner spell, not only when it has a mimicked effect.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Zoe''' casts ''Spell Thief'' or a summoner spell, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration, and summons three bolts that orbit her for the next 10 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Zoe cannot fire bolts while affected by complete crowd control.
mechanics.quote: If '''Zoe''' is not affected by {{tip|complete crowd control}}, she shoots one bolt at a time
